cases.name: health
cases.note: liveness, no DB, no rate limit

cases.name: health-slash-redirect
cases.note: Starlette redirect_slashes: 307 to /health

cases.name: health-head
cases.note: FastAPI routes never answer HEAD: 405

cases.name: unrouted-under-api
cases.note: framework 404 through the problem handler

cases.name: unrouted-root
cases.note: outside /api/v1 too

cases.name: unrouted-slash-root
cases.note: no redirect for /

cases.name: unrouted-with-bad-token
cases.note: no route matched, so no principal: 404 not 401

cases.name: wrong-method
cases.note: 405 internal-error, status kept, no Allow header

cases.name: trailing-slash-redirect
cases.note: 307 to /api/v1/me, before any auth

cases.name: trailing-slash-redirect-query
cases.note: the redirect keeps the query, for any method (partial match)

cases.name: slash-redirect-other-way
cases.note: rstrip('/') strips every trailing slash

cases.name: encoded-slash-routes
cases.note: Starlette routes the decoded path

cases.name: encoded-unknown-path-instance
cases.note: instance is the decoded path

cases.name: factors-anonymous
cases.note: registry from baskfy_core, ETag without a data version

cases.name: columns-if-none-match
cases.note: 304, no body, same validators

cases.name: columns-if-none-match-stale
cases.note: 200 with body

cases.name: columns-garbage-token
cases.note: a bad token is refused even on a public route

cases.name: columns-empty-bearer
cases.note: 'Bearer ' with nothing after it is anonymous

cases.name: trading-days-empty-range
cases.note: a weekend: dates []

cases.name: trading-days-reversed
cases.note: 422 no-trading-day

cases.name: trading-days-exactly-max
cases.note: 1830 days: allowed

cases.name: trading-days-missing-both
cases.note: 400 with two missing errors

cases.name: trading-days-timestamp
cases.note: a midnight unix timestamp is a date

cases.name: me-owner
cases.note: overrides grant the paid bundle; no subscription

cases.name: me-subscriber
cases.note: an active forever plan

cases.name: me-plain
cases.note: tenant isolation: another user's own profile only

cases.name: me-anonymous
cases.note: 401 with WWW-Authenticate

cases.name: me-stale-epoch
cases.note: token epoch below the account's: revoked

cases.name: me-post
cases.note: 405: GET/PATCH/DELETE only (PATCH not ported: compared on POST)

cases.note: Vary: Authorization, Origin

cases.note: a 401 carries CORS headers too

cases.note: no Access-Control-Request-Method: routed, 405
